div.head: VIIa Atr 2
div.ab: ⁊ cume manna gehwilc bærefot to circan buton golde ⁊ glæncgum, ⁊ ga man to scrifte.
⁊ cume manna gehwilc bærefot to circan buton golde ⁊ glæncgum ⁊ ga man to scrifte.
And cume manna gehwilc bærefot to circan, buton golde and glæncgum, and ga man to scrifte.
Und es komme jedermann barfuss zur Kirche ohne Gold und Schmucksachen, und man gehe zur Beichte.
And let everyone come barefoot to church without gold and ornaments, and let people go to confession.
And everyone shall come barefoot to church without gold or ornaments and shall go to confession.
And every man is to come barefoot to church, without gold and ornaments, and to go to confession.
And everyone is to come to church barefoot, without gold or ornaments, and they are to go to confession.
div.note: Gold and ornaments are not in the Latin, but in Napier, No. XXXV.
